roles: Two previously used TRAINING boards. No showcase, ability estimate, validation or formal exam.
selection: One genuine native prefix per designated map/seat. Freeze the first step in probes where the published student naturally supports two distinct legal joint orders. No filtering on margin, cash, units, drawn action, search depth, terminal reward or alternative performance. Source RNG is natural. Keep no-support cases and adverse outcomes. No replacement.
intervention: Capture before either actor consumes the specified observation. Restore the same live official environment, ID counters, clock carry, both policies and private RNG before each branch. Consume the student random draw normally and force only its index at the root. Thereafter normal native sampling until official termination. A = top-ranked supported joint order, B = second ranked. Same initial live original observation, native T=1, deadline 0.58 s. Natural scheduling may affect the root response. Measure it.
runtime: Sequential maps, sequential arms. Both CPU threads of the original may use logical CPUs 0 and 1. Use the same affinity configuration in all branches; record search depth, slow/timeout, wall and CPU, cold and terminal conditions. Local diagnostic with actual limits disclosed, not a ladder resource certification. Preserve all failures.
labels: Record focal official rewards (including extinction), difference B minus A in score margin and in U=0.5*(win+0.5*draw)+0.5*sigmoid(margin/1000), full orders, tree/deposit cash account where identifiable. Root-order training eligibility requires different supported student commands, restored matching state, identical examiner root action, correctly reapplied action tape to official terminal, natural completion with healthy clocks, and at least 80% positive completed search depth among multi-candidate calls in the prefix and separately in each suffix. No such calls makes qualification indeterminate. Ineligible or degenerate labels stay in the report. One draw is one noisy return estimate per action. No winning-game or promotion claim. Any model fit uses training-only rows and a separate test.
